# BondMovingDecimation

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A renormalization-group technique that systematically replaces groups of bonds with effective single bonds, simplifying hierarchical lattice analysis. Enables analytical and numerical study of complex topologies, offering a method to predict emergent behavior in network-on-chip or in-network computing fabrics.
